'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Greg Hatt DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Hatt]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Revenge of Brett P. Hatt
* '''Username:''' boffett
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
